newsitem.title: USA: Monsanto sees combined divs under $0.64/shr.
newsitem.headline: Monsanto sees combined divs under $0.64/shr.

text.p: Monsanto Co said Friday that the combined dividends of the two companies created after the spin-off of its chemicals business would fall short of its current annual payout of $0.64 a share.
Earlier Friday, Monsanto's directors approved payment of a regular quarterly dividend of $0.16 a share on September 12 to stockholders of record on August 15.

That is the last quarterly dividend to be declared by Monsanto before the spin-off. At a special meeting on August 18, shareholders will vote on approving the spin-off, which is expected to be completed by October 1.
Both the chemicals and life sciences buisnesses are evaluating the type of dividend policies they will have after the spin-off.
Chemicals may decide to return earnings to shareholders through cash dividnds and/or stock repurchases, Monsanto said in a news release.
Life sciences is considering its dividend policy in light of its future growth plans, Monsanto said.
While no final decisions have been made, the combined dividends of the two companies are likely to be less than Monsanto's current annual dividend of $0.64 a share, it said.
